LESSON: WORK: GOD WORKED

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation 1.1 Work 8 2.0 The Bible 2.1 Christian Moral Values 10 2.2 Kings David 
Topic 1.1: Work: God Worked

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Work: God Worked. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you work hard as a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics
   In simple words: practise until you can discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Work: God Worked using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Work: God Worked in the examples.
2. Explain Work: God Worked to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Work: God Worked.
4. Show that you can: discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Work: God Worked using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Work: God Worked important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss why it is important to work hard,
2. Team up to read Proverbs 6:6-11, Proverbs 10:4 Exodus 20:11, Genesis 2:1-3; outline the teachings, and write them on charts or PowerPoint slides for presentation in class,
3. Discuss the statement, ‘Having a positive attitude towards work ‘and write key points in their notebooks for presentation in class,
4. Digital Literacy: the skill of interacting with technology is enhanced as learners use digital devices to search online for virtues related to work.
5. Communication and Collaboration: the skill of listening and speaking is portrayed as learners discuss, ‘Having a positive attitude towards work’. 3 Values:

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
